entity.description: Luke and Abel infiltrated the Roosevelt event, but the agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. stopped them from killing Malick. Despite this setback, the Chronicoms followed Malick and the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents Alphonso "Mack" Mackenzie and Deke Shaw to Hell's Harbor, where Freddy was to deliver a component of the Super Soldier Serum to Hydra operatives. They attempted to kill Malick there, but yet again S.H.I.E.L.D. was able to hold them off long enough for Freddy to make the delivery, starting him down on a path towards becoming a Head of Hydra. Abel retreated to the Chronicom ship with Luke, where the Predictor Sibyl told them plans were already underway to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. in 1955.
